var reset_button = {
  id: "reset",
  position: [5,50,8,14],
  clickable: true,
  shortcut: "J",
  visible: true,
  components: [
    { type: "box",position:[0,0,100,100],stroke:"#CDE",width:2},
    { type: "text",position:[10,35,80,30],value:"RESET",color:"#CDE"},
    { type: "text",position:[20,70,60,20],value:"[J]",color:"#CDE"}
  ]
};

var resetShip = function(ship) {
  ship.set({type:101, crystals: 0});
};

const updateDelay = 60;
// frequency 60/updateDelay per sec, eg this one is 60/60 = 1 time per sec
// integer please
const rounding = 2; // digit after decimal sign

let calculateSpeed = function (inGameVelocity) {
  return inGameVelocity * 208.3333333333333;
};

let formatNumber = function (value) {
  return value.toFixed(rounding);
};

let speedUI = function (ship) {
  if (ship === null || ship.id === null) return;
  
   let vx = calculateSpeed(ship.vx), vy = calculateSpeed(ship.vy), v = Math.sqrt(vx*vx + vy*vy), a = "Unknown";
  if (ship.custom.lastSpeed !== null || ship.custom.lastSpeedVx !== null || ship.custom.lastSpeedVy !== null) a = formatNumber((Math.sqrt((vx-ship.custom.lastSpeedVx)*(vx-ship.custom.lastSpeedVx)+(vy-ship.custom.lastSpeedVy)*(vy-ship.custom.lastSpeedVy)))/(3.6*1*9.81));
  
  ship.custom.lastSpeed = v;
  ship.custom.lastSpeedVx = vx
  ship.custom.lastSpeedVy = vy;
  ship.custom.lastUpdatedStep = game.step;
  
  ship.setUIComponent({
    id: "vx",
    position: [5,30,40,3],
    visible: true,
    components: [
      { type: "text",position:[0,0,100,100],align:"left",value: `X-Axis Velocity: ${formatNumber(vx)}km/h`,color:"rgba(255,255,255,1)"}
    ]
  });
  
  ship.setUIComponent({
    id: "vy",
    position: [5,35,40,3],
    visible: true,
    components: [
      { type: "text",position:[0,0,100,100],align:"left",value:`Y-Axis Velocity: ${formatNumber(vy)}km/h`,color:"rgba(255,255,255,1)"}
    ]
  });
  
  ship.setUIComponent({
    id: "total",
    position: [5,40,40,3],
    visible: true,
    components: [
      { type: "text",position:[0,0,100,100],align:"left",value: `Speed: ${formatNumber(v)}km/h`,color:"rgba(255,255,255,1)"}
    ]
  });
  
  ship.setUIComponent({
    id: "accel",
    position: [5,45,40,3],
    visible: true,
    components: [
      { type: "text",position:[0,0,100,100],align:"left",value: `Acceleration: ${a}Gs`,color:"rgba(255,255,255,1)"}
    ]
  });
};



this.tick = function(game) {
  if (game.step % updateDelay === 0) {
    for (let ship of game.ships) {
      if (ship.alive) {
        if (!ship.custom.joined) {
          ship.custom.joined = true;
          ship.set({collider: true});
          ship.setUIComponent(reset_button);
        }
        speedUI(ship);
      }
    }
  }
};

this.event = function(event,game) {
  switch (event.name) {
    case "ui_component_clicked":
      var ship = event.ship;
      var component = event.id;
      if (component == "reset") {
        resetShip(ship);
      }
      break;
  }
};
